sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Manish Maini, Advo
 Mob.9810522996.
 Mr. Bharat Bagga, 
 for R-5.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navin Chawla
 Order
% 19.09.2023
1.
None is appearing for the respondent nos. 1 to 4/the claimants before the learned Tribunal.
2. By way of the Impugned Award, the learned Tribunal has directed that 90% of the compensation awarded shall be paid to the claimants by the petitioner herein.

The petitioner claims that the direction to pay such compensation could not have been issued under the Delhi Victims Compensation Scheme, 2018, which bars the application of the said scheme to the cases covered under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
3.
As none is appearing for the respondent nos.1 to 4/ claimants, I have requested Mr. Manish Maini, learned Advocate, (Mob.981052296) to act as an Amicus Curiae.

4. Let a copy of the paper book of this petition be supplied to the learned Amicus Curiae by the Registry.
5.
He shall file a brief synopsis of the arguments within a period of four weeks from today.
